name: Gold Touch
description: In a baroque palace hall a wave of polished gold rolls over skin and clothes until the subject is a golden statue.

wardrobe.man: an ivory tuxedo jacket, a white shirt and black trousers
wardrobe.woman: a long ivory silk evening gown

scene_prompt: Create a new cinematic film still in {aspect_words} format. {references} The {subject} is the only person in the new still, with exactly {their} face, eyes, nose, jaw, hairline, hairstyle, hair colour{facial_hair}, skin tone and build{identity_notes}. The clothing, the place and the light come only from this description. The {subject} stands in the middle of an empty baroque palace hall, facing the camera, wearing {wardrobe}, {their} right hand raised in front of {their} chest, looking at {their} fingertips. White walls with gilded mouldings, tall mirrors, crystal chandeliers and a polished parquet floor that reflects everything. Medium-wide shot at eye level, perfectly symmetrical, the {subject} centered, full body visible. Cinematic photography, warm chandelier light from above, soft window light from the left. Correct human anatomy, natural skin texture, sharp focus on the {subject}, plain gilded mouldings and clean mirrors throughout.
effect_prompt: Use the provided start image as the first frame. The {subject} ALREADY stands still looking at {their} raised fingertips. Starting at the fingertips, polished liquid gold spreads over the skin and the clothes in a slow rolling wave, up the arm, across the chest, down the body and finally over the face and the hair, until by the last second the {subject} is a gleaming solid gold statue in the same pose, eyes fixed on a point just past the camera, mirror-bright reflections of the chandeliers sliding over the metal. The camera arcs slowly to the right around the {subject} at eye level. Sound: a warm metallic shimmer, a soft ringing like a struck bell, the quiet echo of the hall. Photorealistic, cinematic visual effects, polished gold with real reflections and metallic weight, sharp detail, stable picture.
generic_prompt: Use the provided start image as the first frame. The {subject} in the frame slows to a stop. Starting at one hand, polished liquid gold spreads over the skin and the clothes in a slow rolling wave, up the arm, across the body and finally over the face and the hair, until by the last second the {subject} is a gleaming solid gold statue in the same pose, reflections sliding over the metal. The camera keeps the same framing and the same movement it already has. Sound: a warm metallic shimmer, a soft ringing like a struck bell. Photorealistic, cinematic visual effects, polished gold with real reflections and metallic weight, sharp detail, stable picture.
